# ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a list of Azure certificates known to CipherTrust Manager. Supply a `filters` map to narrow the results. Each certificate version is a separate entry, so use the `version` filter with the value `-1` to return only the latest version of each certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notes
# - Each certificate version is a separate entry. Use the version filter with the value
#   "-1" to return only the latest version of each certificate.
# - The default limit is 10. Use limit = "-1" to return all matches.
# - All filter values must be strings, for example "true" rather than true.

# List certificates (first 10 by default)
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "all" {}

# List all certificates, latest version only
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "latest" {
  filters = {
    version = "-1"
    limit   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the certificates of a vault by vault name
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_vault_name" {
  filters = {
    key_vault = "my-key-vault"
    version   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the certificates of a vault by CipherTrust Manager vault ID, newest first
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_vault_id" {
  filters = {
    key_vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.id
    version      = "-1"
    sort         = "-createdAt"
  }
}

# Find a certificate by name
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_name" {
  filters = {
    cert_name = "my-certificate"
    version   = "-1"
  }
}

# List the latest version of each enabled certificate
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "enabled_latest" {
  filters = {
    enabled = "true"
    version = "-1"
  }
}

# List certificates uploaded from CipherTrust Manager.
# These have a cert_source of "local". Native certificates have a cert_source of "native".
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "uploaded" {
  filters = {
    cert_source = "local"
    version     = "-1"
  }
}

# Find a certificate by the Azure certificate, key or secret identifier of one version
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_cid" {
  filters = {
    cid = "https://my-key-vault.vault.azure.net/certificates/my-certificate/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  }
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_kid" {
  filters = {
    kid = "https://my-key-vault.vault.azure.net/keys/my-certificate/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  }
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_sid" {
  filters = {
    sid = "https://my-key-vault.vault.azure.net/secrets/my-certificate/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  }
}

# Find the versions of a certificate by backup.
# All versions of a certificate share the same backup. A new backup is made each time
# a version is created, so use the backup of the latest version.
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "by_backup" {
  filters = {
    backup = ciphertrust_azure_certificate.latest.backup
  }
}

# Filter by key algorithm.
# The value is case-sensitive. A native certificate keeps the kty it was created with, for example "RSA".
# An uploaded certificate takes its kty from the imported certificate, which can be lowercase, for example "rsa".
data "ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list" "rsa" {
  filters = {
    algorithm = "RSA"
    version   = "-1"
  }
}

output "latest_certificate_names" {
  value = [for c in data.ciphertrust_azure_certificate_list.latest.certificates : c.name]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs matching CipherTrust Manager API query parameters for listing Azure certificates.

> **Note:** Although some filters represent integers or booleans, all filter values must be specified as strings. For example, use `"-1"` rather than `-1`.

| filter               | type    | description |
|----------------------|---------|-------------|
| skip                 | integer | Index of the first result to return (default: 0). |
| limit                | integer | Maximum number of results to return (default: 10). Use `"-1"` to return all matches. |
| sort                 | string  | Fields to sort by. Prefix with `-` for descending order (for example, `-createdAt`). |
| id                   | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource ID. |
| key_vault            | string  | Filter by key vault name. |
| key_vault_id         | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager vault resource ID. |
| cert_name            | string  | Filter by Azure certificate name. |
| cloud_name           | string  | Filter by cloud name (for example, `AzureCloud`). |
| region               | string  | Filter by region. |
| curve                | string  | Filter by EC curve (for example, `P-256`). The value is not case-sensitive. |
| status               | string  | Filter by certificate status. |
| backup               | string  | Filter by backup. |
| enabled              | boolean | Filter by the enabled attribute. |
| deleted_in_azure     | boolean | Filter by whether the certificate has been deleted in Azure. |
| soft_deleted_in_azure | boolean | Filter by whether the certificate has been soft-deleted in Azure. |
| algorithm            | string  | Filter by algorithm type (for example, `RSA` or `EC`). The value is not case-sensitive. |
| cid                  | string  | Filter by Azure certificate identifier. |
| kid                  | string  | Filter by Azure key identifier. |
| sid                  | string  | Filter by Azure secret identifier. |
| gone                 | boolean | Filter by gone. |
| version              | string  | Filter by version. Use `"-1"` to return only the latest version of each certificate. |
| tags                 | string  | A valid JSON value. Certificates whose tags contain the JSON value are returned. |
| cert_material_origin | string  | Filter by certificate material origin. |
| cert_source          | string  | Filter by certificate source. |

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) List of Azure certificates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `matched` (Number) Total number of certificates matching the given filters.
